'''Doom''' was a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He wore a unique set of [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] composed of a green, yellow, and gray color scheme. He was involved in the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|Battle of Ringo Vinda]] along with [[Doom's unit|his men]].

==Biography==
[[File:CommanderDoom-TCW.png|thumb|left|175px|Doom in his Phase II clone trooper armor]]
Born on the home world planet of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Doom was bred from bounty hunter [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] as a commander of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. He served under Jedi Twin Masters [[Tiplar/Legends|Tiplar]] and [[Tiplee/Legends|Tiplee]], and the battles he participated in heavily scored and scuffed his armor. Doom participated in the Battle of Ringo Vinda along with the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. After many rotations, neither the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|forces]] nor the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] had gained any ground. When debriefing during the next attack, Doom said that he would need backup, for he was low on manpower. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] assigned ten troopers of the 501st, led by [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] and [[Tup/Legends|Tup]], to assist him for the next wave. When very near victory in the following battle, Tup began acting strangely, as if in a trance, and unexpectedly shot Master Tiplar. The loss of the Jedi was a strong blow and the momentum the Republic had built up was very quickly reversed; a last formation of [[Droideka/Legends|Droidekas]] and [[Super battle droid rocket trooper/Legends|rocket droids]] was deployed and the clones were forced to retreat.<ref name="Kamino's Finest">{{SW|url=news/kaminos-finest-captains-and-commanders-of-the-clone-army|text=Kamino's Finest: Captains and Commanders of the Clone Army|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Doom wore standard [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] with the additions of an antenna and light on his helmet. He also sported a [[Kama/Legends|kama]] and visor. Like many clone commanders, Doom wielded twin [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]]. Unlike most armor patterns, Doom's was almost entirely green with yellow highlights, leaving only his arms and lower legs white. He sported the yellow triangular markings of his unit on his visor and chest.
Doom's armor was heavily worn, bearing scuff marks and smears on every exposed surface. Despite this, the visor on his helmet was kept in optimal condition.

==Behind the scenes==
Doom's uniform pattern and his name are references to the [[Marvel Comics]] villain [[Wikipedia:Doctor Doom|Doctor Doom]].<ref name="The Unknown trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-unknown-episode-guide|text="The Unknown" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> Coincidentally, Doctor Doom also partly acted as the inspiration for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Doctor Doom inspired Vader">{{WebCite|url=https://www.inverse.com/article/35956-doctor-doom-darth-vader-jack-kirby-marvel-star-wars-stan-lee|text=Wait, is Darth Vader Totally a Doctor Doom Rip-off?|author=Britt, Ryan|date=2017-08-28|work=[https://www.inverse.com Inverse]|archivedate=20200419094618}}</ref>
